definition: A metric from OptimalThinkingBench for scoring overthinking: Overthinking-Adjusted Accuracy (OAA_t) counts a response correct only if it also stays under a thinking-token threshold t, and AUC_OAA is the area under the OAA_t curve as t sweeps up to 1000 tokens. A model that reaches the right answer but keeps generating unnecessary tokens scores lower on AUC_OAA than one that stops promptly, even at equal raw accuracy.

evidence.note: Introduces OptimalThinkingBench, a unified benchmark pairing OverthinkingBench (simple queries) and UnderthinkingBench (hard reasoning/math) with a shared F1 metric, showing that none of 33 evaluated LLMs balances accuracy and thinking-token efficiency.
evidence.title: OptimalThinkingBench: Evaluating Over and Underthinking in LLMs
